title: Google Maps Scraper Results
description: Scraped Google Maps business listings with contact details and metadata

searchString.title: Search Query
searchString.description: The Google Maps search query that returned this listing

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address of the business from search results

fullAddress.title: Full Address
fullAddress.description: Complete full address including city, state, zip, country. Only populated when fullAddress mode is enabled.

addressStreet.title: Address — Street
addressStreet.description: Street and number component of full address

addressZip.title: Address — Zip Code
addressZip.description: Zip/postal code component of full address

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Latitude extracted from Google Maps place URL

lng.title: Longitude
lng.description: Longitude extracted from Google Maps place URL

website.title: Website URL
website.description: Business website URL with tracking parameters stripped

isClaimed.title: Is Claimed
isClaimed.description: Whether the business has claimed its Google Maps listing. null if unknown.

category.title: Business Category
category.description: Google Maps category (e.g. Concrete contractor, Plumber)

totalScore.title: Star Rating
totalScore.description: Average star rating on Google Maps (1.0-5.0)

placeUrl.title: Google Maps URL
placeUrl.description: URL to the business's Google Maps place page

scrapedAt.title: Scraped At
scrapedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the listing was scraped

_isNew.title: Is New Listing
_isNew.description: Whether this listing was first seen in the current run. Only when incremental mode is enabled.

_placeId.title: Place ID (Hash)
_placeId.description: Stable hash identifier for this place
